summary: Iteration 4 backend regression covering the expanded ZapPedidos backend (WhatsApp unified WAHA/Evolution provider, LAD Delivery endpoints, product CRUD, webhook->chats, multi-tenant isolation, plan limits, brute-force lockout). 14/16 tests passed; 2 real backend bugs identified.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 when the configured WAHA/Evolution provider URL is offline/unreachable. WhatsAppProvider.start_session() executes httpx.post() outside any try/except, so httpx.ConnectError propagates. Review checklist explicitly required graceful handling here. get_qr() and status() are wrapped in try/except but start_session() is NOT. Reproduce: setup with base_url=http://127.0.0.1:59999 -> 500 + httpx.ConnectError in backend.err.log.

minor.issue: MongoDB projection only excludes wa_token and lad_token but not the legacy secret fields waha_token / evolution_token. Stores migrated from previous iterations still expose waha_token in the response. Extend projection (or clean() helper) to include waha_token, waha_url, evolution_token.

action_items: Wrap httpx calls inside WhatsAppProvider.start_session() with try/except httpx.HTTPError returning {status: 'error', message: ...}, mirroring get_qr()/status()/logout(). This is the primary fix.

Extend the .find() projection in /api/dashboard and /api/stores (and clean() helper) to strip legacy waha_token / waha_url / evolution_token fields for backwards compatibility with pre-migration documents.
critical_code_review_comments: WhatsAppProvider.start_session() lacks the try/except that the other three methods have — inconsistent and directly caused a 500 in tests.

clean() strips waha_token from single-doc responses but the store-list endpoints rely on MongoDB projection which misses legacy keys. Preferring clean() over projection for list endpoints would guarantee consistency.
server.py is one 811-line file; consider splitting providers/routers into modules once feature growth continues (soft rec).

PATCH /api/stores/{id}: when a client sends only disallowed fields the endpoint silently returns 200 with no change — consider returning 400 to give a clearer signal (currently tested to pass since bot_ativo is included).
Login endpoint sets cookie with secure=True unconditionally; fine for the preview HTTPS environment but would break local HTTP dev.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST-prefixed stores + client users during the run and cleaned them up in the module teardown fixture (deletes any store whose name starts with 'TEST').
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent wraps start_session() in try/except and updates the store list projection, re-run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_zappedidos_iter4.py. The two currently failing tests are test_dashboard_uses_wa_status_migrated and test_whatsapp_setup_and_qr_offline_graceful. Cookie zp_session works with requests.Session across the preview URL. Webhook endpoint accepts both WAHA (from/body/fromMe) and Evolution (key.remoteJid, message.conversation) payload shapes correctly.
rca of the issue: Root cause #1 (500 on setup): server.py line 200 — start_session() calls httpx.post directly; no exception wrapper. Fix: mirror status()/get_qr() pattern with try/except httpx.HTTPError returning {'status':'error','message':str(exc)}. Root cause #2 (waha_token leak): server.py lines 400 & 418 — projection dict only lists wa_token/lad_token. Legacy documents created before the wa_* rename still contain waha_token. Either extend the projection to {'waha_token':0,'waha_url':0,'evolution_token':0} or route the results through clean().
